$comment: VFX preset overrides (SPEC §24.5). By default the preset follows the primary damage type (slashing/piercing/bludgeoning → force), healing spells use `healing`, and everything else is `arcane`. These entries override the default where the spell has no damage or healing formula but is plainly light, darkness or restoration magic.

light.source: "the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet" — light magic.

daylight.source: "sunlight spreads from a point within range and fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere" — sunlight.

dancing-lights.source: "You create up to four torch-size lights within range" — light magic.

faerie-fire.source: "Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice)." — light magic.

continual-flame.source: "A flame springs from an object that you touch." — a flame that gives no heat.

darkness.source: "magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere" — the black-violet necrotic look fits magical darkness better than the arcane circle.

power-word-heal.source: "A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range. The target regains all its Hit Points."

revivify.source: "You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point."

resurrection.source: "With a touch, you revive a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century".

true-resurrection.source: "The creature is revived with all its Hit Points."

lesser-restoration.source: "You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned."

greater-restoration.source: "You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it".

spare-the-dying.source: "Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn’t dead. The creature becomes Stable."

beacon-of-hope.source: "each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing."
